notes.title: 🛠️ Small Update – Brightness Settings + Inventory Fix
notes.content:
📺 Added brightness settings!
A few players mentioned the game was too dark, so you can now adjust the brightness to your liking.

🧠 Fixed a major bug where organs and trap items weren’t showing up correctly in the inventory after dying or reloading a save. This should now work as intended.

Thanks for the feedback, keep it coming!
The update is live now. 🩸

notes.title: 🛠 Small Update – Smoother Movement, Same Tension
notes.content:
I’ve updated the moving platform room!

🚶‍♂️ No more awkward jumping. The platforms now let you walk across, but you still need to time it right to make it through.
The old jumping felt too much like a platformer, and it didn’t fit the tone. This should feel more natural and intense, without the frustration.

Thanks for all the feedback, more tweaks are on the way!
